correctness.rationale: Verified the exact invariant population triangle y_i>=0,z_i>=0,y_i+z_i<=1 and Perron identity at rho(Gamma^-1 W)=1 for irreducible W: A=W-Gamma has a simple zero eigenvalue v>0 and w>0, u=w^T y, u'=-w^T[(y+z)⊙Wy]<=0. Every positive-infection trajectory becomes strictly componentwise infected; LaSalle yields (y,z)->0. Relative slow variation u(t-r)/u(t)->1 and exponential stable semigroups yield y=vu+p u²+o(u²), z=h u+q u²+o(u²), h=Delta^-1 Gamma v, Ap=b-Kv on w^T p=0, q=Delta^-1(Gamma p+Kh), K=w^T[(v+h)⊙Wv]>0. Multiplication gives u'=-Ku²-Lu³+o(u³), so t y->v/K, t z->h/K and (u^-1-Kt)/log t->L/K (not necessarily O(1) remainder). Independently used symbolic matrix algebra on the exact specified W=[[3/4,1/4],[1/2,3/2]], Gamma=diag(1,2), Delta=dI: w=(2/3,1/3), v=(1,1), exact Ap projection, K=2(2d+3)/(3d), L/K=-(8d³+45d²+27d-54)/(9d²(2d+3)). Its cubic has strictly positive derivative on d>0, unique root 0.795652212912595; sign reverses. Finite symbolic checks corroborate but do not prove global critical trajectories.
